_source: Acharya et al., arXiv:2408.13687v1 (Willow), read from the full PDF text [V] on 2026-10-08: Table S1 (Fig. 1d column), Table S5, main text p.2-3. Values are reported, not measured by us.
_eps_fit_method: per code and basis, line through ln(1 - 2 pL) versus cycles t; eps = (1 - exp(slope))/2; excess residuals (drift) inflate the uncertainty; the mean over codes and bases has uncertainty sqrt(sum sigma_i^2)/n. Lambda: regression of ln eps_d on (d + 1)/2 with eps uncertainties, Lambda = exp(-slope).
_shots: 50,000 per (cycles, basis, code): 10 initialization bitstrings (5 random and their complements) x 5,000 repetitions

table_S5_nn_eps._note: neural-network decoder, per grid and basis: [eps, std. dev.]; grid (a, b) <-> open-source label 'd<d> a+bj' (e.g. distance-3 (0, 4) <-> d3 0+4j)
